name: ServiceRequestSourcePresenceReviewLifecycle
scope: Advanced Search Service Request source-presence warning history only; source field projection and ticket lifecycle remain separate authorities.

state_type.name: SrSourcePresenceStateV1
rules: no history => latest fields null, active_disappearance_event_id null, warning_active=false

base_token.canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exactly: ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), UTF-8; lowercase SHA-256 of exact canonical bytes
base_token.rule: proposal generation and disappearance acceptance use the identical reader algorithm; any SR revision or presence-chain-head change changes the token

disappearance_acceptance: AcceptReconciliationProposal owns the one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork and receipt; ServiceRequestImportMutationService creates no nested receipt/commit.

before owner mutation, LLD-04 revalidates pending sr_source_disappearance_review revision/fingerprint/base token and population_absence evidence against the exact current complete published Advanced Search run
LLD-03 recomputes SOMA_SR_SOURCE_PRESENCE_BASE_V1 in the supplied writer UnitOfWork and requires exact equality with the proposal base-state token

SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider.validate_disappearance_acceptance proves proposal kind/evidence mode/target SR/current import_run/prior_source_observation and canonical prior SR identity; INVALID or INDETERMINATE fails closed

an active disappearance warning is not opened twice: proposal generation suppresses a new review while warning_active=true; commit-time head drift makes an older proposal stale unless exact outer command replay already returned its recorded result

after the outer receipt exists, append one disappearance_reviewed event linked to the current chain head (null only for the first event), add the registered LLD-03 source-presence audit/result reference, then allow LLD-04 disposition/run-counter writes and commit
no Service Request identity/lifecycle/source-field projection/Customer/Contact/Current Handler/RFC relationship or other ticket authority is changed
reappearance_reconciliation: LLD-04 owns all post-publication scheduling, pagination, retry and checkpoint mechanics; LLD-03 owns only the bounded source-presence participant described here.

LLD-04 invokes one replay-safe internal reappearance resolution command only for a current SR whose SrSourcePresenceStateV1 reports warning_active=true and supplies the exact expected active disappearance event plus immutable published source-observation evidence.

inside that command writer UnitOfWork, LLD-03 exact-compares expected_active_disappearance_event_id to the current chain head, then SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider.validate_reappearance_evidence proves the source_observation belongs to the exact published advanced_search_sr run, has a conflict-free canonical eight-digit SR identity equal to the current official SR, and is valid evidence of row presence

field-level warnings, missing optional fields, unknown controlled values or unusable non-identity fields do not block reappearance when canonical SR identity evidence is valid; acceptance of any source field value is out of scope

append one reappearance_confirmed event whose prior_presence_event_id is the exact active disappearance event, add the registered LLD-03 audit/result reference, and commit; provider or head drift INVALID/INDETERMINATE fails closed without clearing the warning
exact replay of that internal command returns the recorded result without rereading mutable current presence/source state
a later reviewed disappearance appends a new disappearance_reviewed event after the reappearance head, preserving every prior cycle
query_projection: GetServiceRequest reads only LLD-03 presence history and emits warning code SR_SOURCE_DISAPPEARANCE_REVIEWED exactly when the current chain head is disappearance_reviewed
pending/rejected/deferred/superseded disappearance proposals are LLD-04 evidence only and never surface as an LLD-03 domain warning
reappearance clearing is reflected when its LLD-03 event commits; history remains immutable and independently inspectable
transaction_rules: LLD-04 proposal acceptance and each internal reappearance resolution command use exactly one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork/receipt
cross-packet providers are read-only validators in the caller UnitOfWork and never commit
LLD-03 accepts only one bounded per-SR reappearance mutation per command and contains no source-population scheduling authority
no runtime sequence-14 schema/code may be activated before the accepted migration prefix 1..13 exists
failure_rules: failed LLD-04 publication cannot lawfully invoke the reappearance participant because only published evidence validates
failed per-SR resolution rolls back its receipt/event/audit/result
exact replay returns the original result without rereading mutable current presence/source state
